title: biomes.field/1
description: data/biomes/field.json: planet generation 3's ground, a field of nodes on a cube-sphere (docs/world/ring-any-angle/research.md T6 stage 3; WorldField). Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore.

cells.description: Cells along a face's edge: the canonical lattice (38,400 / cells units a cell). A multiple of bakeStride.

warm.description: Nodes read ahead (WorldField.warmNear; docs/world/node-warm.md): at a match start every canonical node within radius units of the touch-down is read, so a view or a ring that later reads that ground finds it (a node is a pure function of the seed and the data: the result of nothing changes, only when the cost is paid; about 41 microseconds a cold node: 8,000 units is about 0.3 s, 16,000 about 1.2 s). 0 is off.

bakeStride.description: The bake is every bakeStride-th node of the canonical lattice.

enabled.description: Off, a gen 3 place is laid from the chord as gen 2's is.

yawSteps.description: A place's street axis is one of this many yaws in a half turn, keyed by the planet and the place.

align.description: Turn a place's plan to the ring it is first laid on, so its street runs along the line and a band lies on the lanes (as dense as the chord layout). Off, the street's yaw is keyed by the planet and the place.

bandsCity.description: A city's plan is the street's strip laid this many times each side of the middle one, a lane-band (pitchBH) apart, so a ring at any bearing crosses several.

pitchBH.description: The distance between bands, in fighter heights (the depth of the fight lanes' band, 32).

farPeople.description: On (with everywhere), the buildings of the places the first ring does not hold have their people, asleep until the place is first within farReach of a fighter (Game Design, docs/world/ring-any-angle/game-design.md section 15, addendum of 2026-11-01).

farAnguish.description: On (with farPeople), a far town's people count toward the hero's anguish by their place's share when it is first posed, and feed nothing else: not menace, power, Witness or mood.

farShare.description: A far place, wholly lost, counts toward the hero's anguish as this many first-ring places' worth of people (the average one's); a part lost counts in proportion to the place's own people, so a larger place does not cost more by size (Legal RL-228 term 3).

maxFootSlope.description: With everywhere, the steepest ground (rise over run) allowed between a free building's centre and any of eight points on the circle round its footprint; a building on a cliff is not laid (docs/world/lot-gap.md). A hillside town stands on 0.3 to 0.6, a cliff is 3 or more. 0: no limit.

indexFrontBH.description: With everywhere, the depth in front of the line (z positive toward the camera), in fighter heights (bh = 75 units), past which a planet-fixed building's FRONT FACE (its z plus half its depth) is not indexed (so not struck, and Rendering's rule has lowered it): -2 (-150 units); a first-ring block's face is -2.5.

indexBackBH.description: With everywhere, the depth behind the line, in fighter heights, out to which a building is indexed if that is further than swing.json indexBand: the background lane's far edge (44.5).

farReach.description: A far place is posed (its people wake, and join the anguish's norm) when a fighter is within this many units of its first building.

everywhere.description: On, every place the first ring does not hold is laid too, as the whole of its plan, planet-fixed, with no people (docs/world/places-everywhere.md). Off, only the first ring's places stand.

minBuildings.description: A place that would stand fewer buildings than this on a ring falls back to the chord layout.

enabled.description: Keep a gen 3 planet's bake in user://field-cache/ (the page origin's IndexedDB on the web) and read it back on a repeat visit. The key is the data hash, the Godot version, the seed, the generation, the cells and the stride; a file is checked by its key text, length, SHA-256, six fresh witness nodes and its rebuilt bake hash, and any fault bakes as before.

keep.description: Files kept; the oldest go (a bake is about 208 KB, a made planet about 200 KB).

pool.description: Also keep the nodes beyond the bake that matches read (sim/world/field_pool.gd): a node is a point of the planet, so a pool serves every ring.

planet.description: Also keep the made planet (the climate grid and the places) and read it back (sim/world/planet_cache.gd).

sidewalk.description: A lot edge is its buildings footprints plus this many units (Art rule: one lot per street block, the footprints plus a sidewalk).

blendSide.description: The bank beside a lot, across the street: it eases into the ground over at most this many units (and at most half the gap to the nearest lot beside it).

gradeAcross.description: A lot also leans across its street by the slope between the ground at its two sides, at most this rise over run (0: level across, as before): a street on a hillside tilts a little instead of cutting a bank into it.

grade.description: A lot's flat climbs with its street by at most this rise over run (its least-squares slope along the street); 0 keeps every lot level.

blendMax.description: A lot eases into the ground beyond its edge over at most this many units (and at most half the gap to the nearest other lot): the ramp down an avenue.

gap.description: Buildings of one row of a place that stand within this many units of each other (no avenue between) share a lot.

sub.description: A refined cell is read at this many times the resolution (4: 32 units, a ring column).

step.description: A cell whose corners differ by more than this many units is refined (a wall, a cliff).

shoreBand.description: A cell whose corner heights span the shoreline height (WorldWater.SHORE_WET), widened by this many units each side, is refined.
